span.p:
write Q: TS less than R-TS(Q) or W-TS(Q) aborts
uncommitted writer means WAIT
else allow, W-TS = TS
no Thomas write rule, it is not conflict serializable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
waits always go younger to older, so no deadlock
restarted tx gets a new, larger timestamp

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CCM facade · CC1
rejects requests unless status is ACTIVE
prints active protocol at startup

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
txn/ · CC1
TxTable: txId to status, timestamp, held items
AtomicLong txId, start above maxSeen after recovery CC-05
quiesce gate: hold new begins, signal when active = 0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
protocol/ · CC-02
chosen by config at startup,
switch refused while transactions are active

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
LockTable: item to holders + FIFO wait queue
S compatible with S, X exclusive
re-request or weaker lock granted, no duplicate
S to X upgrade, upgrader queued first

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deadlock detector thread
wait-for graph, checked every 1 s, resolved within 5 s
victim = youngest txId in the cycle
non-cycle waiters never aborted

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
release all locks only after COMMIT is durable
or rollback finished, then wake waiters

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bridge/ abort flow · CC-04 · CC3
one path for every abort reason

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
bridge/ · CC-03
exactly one change record per write permission,
none for reads

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
verify/ · CC-09 · CC4
records committed operations,
precedence graph, cycle check, equivalent serial order
also runs on a hand-written schedule

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
driver/ · CC-10 · CC5
one thread per transaction in the schedule,
prints allowed / wait / aborted per op, final schedule,
serializability verdict, pass/fail vs expected
